tbesh_html:
1) pot, basin, laver, pan
1a) pot, caldron
1b) fire-pot, brazier
1c) basin, laver
1d) platform, stage

strongs_1890.strongs_def: properly, something round (as excavated or bored), i.e. a chafing-dish forcoals or a caldron forcooking; hence (from similarity of form) a washbowl; also (for the same reason) a pulpit or platform
strongs_1890.derivation: or כִּיֹּר; from the same as H3564 (כּוּר);
